result: the included module compiles and runs; the Y card's parameter is ignored: I(V1) = -1.00000000e-03 (the module default r = 1k), no message; a module tagged DIODE level 2002 with .model dm d level=2002 r=2k: on the 2026-09-29 library the card bound Xyce's built-in DIODE_CMC ("No model parameter R found for model DM of type D, parameter ignored", I(V1) = -3.395e-7, Device Count Summary D level 2002 (DIODE_CMC 2.0.0)); on the launcher vamos runs since 2026-10-10 (DEVELOPMENT-202610100047, 7cd78110) the .hdl module is bound on the card ("compiled and registered mydio", .op listing: 1 mydio model DM with R 2000, 1 instance D1), the module still runs with its default r = 1k (I(V1) = -1.00000000e-03: the card value is listed but not applied, as on the Y form), neither DIODE_CMC message appears and the Device Count Summary prints only the total. The fixture pins the 2026-10-10 observation (design section 14 q.50). T1 runs these under env_for (E96)
